Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Jon Casual Farmhouse Wood Dining Table, 54"-72"W, Birch Finish
Colors: Beige
Materials: wood
54"L x 54-72"W x 30"H Solid hardwood made of poplar; birch veneer A simple design and rustic finish make it casual and ideal for a modern farmhouse décor A great table for dining or doing homework and crafts Assembly in 30 minutes or less; attach base to top Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This handsome rustic table is ideal for a lake house -- or for adding a warm natural touch to your home. The solid hardwood and sturdy construction will last through many family dinners, and an extra leaf allows you to extend the round table to a longer oval when needed.
